lines.text: Every warehouse starts as a drawing.
Rams maps every aisle, rack and dock.
Then builds the whole site in 3D. Every frame, every beam, every route your trucks take.
In 4D, it remembers. Sensors log every impact and every move, all year.
5D turns damage into a bill of quantities: the exact parts, and the cost.
6D plans shorter routes for your fleet. Less driving. Less energy.
7D spots a beam drifting toward its limit, and gets it replaced before it fails.
And 8D is safety. When a rack gets hit, you know in seconds, and the bay is made safe.
Rams Digital Twin. Your entire warehouse, from 2D to 8D.
